method: CUA browser CSS metrics, native JPEG scene captures and contiguous full-reader parts at 390/360; actual in-app scroll of image-reference reader also verified. Embedded/source/native artwork checked separately for byte equality.

visual_review.scope: All 18 adopted scenes captured at both CSS widths; all 8 recomposed scenes visually reviewed at both widths; remaining 10 previously reviewed scenes retain their native art and lettering.
visual_review.limitations: Browser captures only; no physical device or user approval. Visual legibility is not proof of comprehension or empathy.

sequence: VR login and player-controlled skill check
walk to workshop and own prototype returned
open equipment details and show efficient design
open log to distinguish reserve from stopped output
inspect and clear clogged cooling vent
test the same sword and confirm third-strike enhancement
invitation to fight together and accept party
checks: No repair diagnosis before the failure is observed
No assumption that Kai attended the shared adventure screenshot
Maker and ownership explicitly stated
One prototype blade tracked throughout
No blackout or new quest in this episode
Sword identity and enhancement shown before heat explanation
Circuit design specialty demonstrated in equipment result, not just skill number
Interface perspective and input action specified
No automatically revealed physical clog diagnosis in the log
Sounds match the drawn action and are near the source
No speech balloons or tails around sound effects
Dialogue changes limited to sword effect, heat mechanism and design comparison; other adopted speech preserved
Listener reactions, doubt, invitation and relief retain quiet
sound_review.limitations: Browser captures only. Small ambient lettering is intentionally subdued; no claim that every glyph is at least 20px. No physical device or reader acceptance.
sound_review.scope: 13 prior action sounds plus 5 interface-action sounds; quiet reaction and relief panels preserved.

checks: Kai opens status: sword skill 12 / circuit design 68
Named sword: slash enhancement +30%, MP2 per strike
Sena compares same power at half the market sword cost
Kai opens logs; MP remains while enhancement stops
Heat is a conversion loss; safety stops enhancement, not the steel blade
Third repaired strike reports enhancement active
Sena sends party invitation; Kai accepts it
Sword remains with Sena until handover; Kai then holds it in right bare hand
game_review.limitations: Browser and model review; no physical device or reader acceptance.

checks: Borderless tower, street path and sunset scenery lead the eye downward
Same-row short action and dialogue inserts read right then left
Two practice strikes grouped before a quiet pause and stopped blade
Third-strike result follows hesitation and deliberate inter-scene pause
Successful result precedes a quiet pause and relief
Invitation question appears before its answer, with quiet eye reaction afterwards
Exact dialogue, HUD rows and all 18 sound cues retained
Bare hand, right-hand sword and left-arm shield continuity checked
scroll_review.limitations: Geometry and model visual review; not physical-device testing or user story-quality approval.

browser_recovery: Existing automation tab stopped attaching after page-internal navigation; a new tab in the same in-app browser opened the adopted image-reference reader, and its screenshot and scroll were verified.
